newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sells wheat and flour in food aid tender.
newsitem.headline: France sells wheat and flour in food aid tender.

text.p: France sold 10,000 tonnes of soft wheat and 5,840 tonnes of soft wheat flour at a food aid tender held on October 22, France's grain office ONIC said on Friday.
It sold 6,000 tonnes of soft wheat to Ethiopia and 4,000 tonnes of soft wheat to Eritrea at 1,089 francs per tonne, FOB Port La Nouvelle.
It also sold 5,840 tonnes of soft wheat flour to Yemen at 1,655 francs per tonne, FOB Sete.
Both the wheat and the soft wheat flour are for shipment between November 6 and November 30.
